claims.claim: A study of 2,094 movies from 1992 to 2012 found violent content linked to higher ticket sales among PG-13 films, and not to broader U.S. violence or adolescent reactance.
claims.episode_span: Among PG-13 films, violent content was linked to increased ticket sales.
claims.supporting_quote: We find that violent content is linked neither to violence in the broader U.S. culture (i.e., the reflective model) nor to a psychological reactance by adolescents (i.e., the reactance model).

claims.claim: In a sample of 515 Hollywood films, passing the Bechdel test significantly improved international box office earnings, with the effect depending on socioeconomic development.
claims.episode_span: Passing the test significantly improved international box office earnings.
claims.source_title: Hollywood caught in two worlds? The impact of the Bechdel test on the international box office performance of cinematic films
claims.supporting_quote: Using a sample of 515 randomly selected Hollywood films, it is shown that passing the test significantly improves international box office earnings.

claims.claim: In 51 science-fiction film adaptations, title adaptation, novel popularity and the director's adaptation experience had significant impacts on box office.
claims.episode_span: Three factors had significant impacts on box office: adaptation of the title, popularity of the original novel, and the director's experience in film adaptation.
claims.source_title: How does film adaptation influence box office performance? An empirical analysis of science fiction films in Hollywood
claims.supporting_quote: Empirical analysis demonstrates that the adaptation of the title, the popularity of the original novel and the director's experience in film adaptation have significant impacts on box office performance.

claims.claim: A BP neural network using seven box-office inputs was more accurate than multiple linear regression at predicting Chinese film box office trend.
claims.episode_span: The network was more accurate than a classical multiple linear regression model and could predict the overall trend.
claims.source_title: Research on Mathematical Model of Box Office Forecast through BP Neural Network and Big Data Technology
claims.supporting_quote: The results show that the prediction model based on BP neural network is more accurate than the classical Multiple Linear Regression model.
